topicName: Test Scripts and Chai Assertion Library
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Tutorial: Test Scripts and Chai Assertion Library in Postman"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Postman allows you to write test scripts in JavaScript to validate API responses. These tests execute after the request is sent, utilizing the built-in Chai Assertion Library to check response data, status codes, and headers."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding Postman Test Scripts"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Test scripts in Postman are written under the \"Tests\" tab of any request. Postman provides a powerful sandbox environment and snippets to help you get started quickly with common testing patterns."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction to the Chai Assertion Library"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"Chai is a BDD/TDD assertion library that can be delightfully paired with any javascript testing framework. Postman uses Chai.js v4.3.x, allowing you to use expressive interfaces like 'expect' to write readable and reliable assertions."},{"order":7,"type":"subheading","text":"Common Chai Assertion Patterns"},{"order":8,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Checking Response Status: pm.response.to.have.status(200);"},{"order":9,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Validating Response Body Properties: expect(jsonData.name).to.eql(\"John Doe\");"},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Checking Data Types: expect(jsonData.id).to.be.a(\"number\");"},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Validating Array Contents: expect(jsonData.tags).to.include(\"admin\");"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Step-by-Step Implementation"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"Follow these steps to add a comprehensive test script to your Postman request:"},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Open Postman and select your desired API request."},{"order":15,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Click on the \"Tests\" tab located below the URL input field."},{"order":16,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Paste the provided JavaScript code snippet into the editor."},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Click \"Send\" and inspect the \"Test Results\" tab in the response viewer."},{"order":18,"type":"subheading","text":"Example Test Script"},{"order":19,"type":"code","text":"pm.test(\"Status code is 200\", function () {\\n    pm.response.to.have.status(200);\\n});\\n\\nconst jsonData = pm.response.json();\\n\\npm.test(\"Verify user details\", function () {\\n    expect(jsonData).to.be.an(\"object\");\\n    expect(jsonData.username).to.equal(\"johndoe\");\\n    expect(jsonData.email).to.be.a(\"string\");\\n});"},{"order":20,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion"},{"order":21,"type":"paragraph","text":"By leveraging Postman test scripts and the Chai assertion library, you can automate your API validation workflow, ensure data integrity, and catch regression issues early in the development lifecycle."}]
